props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content or render function receiving the copy state.
A render function must declare its parameter, even when unused.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: copiedDuration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds to hold the 'copied' state before returning to 'idle'.

props.name: copiedIcon
props.description: Icon displayed when copied.

props.name: copiedTone
props.description: Color tone while copied.

props.name: copiedVariant
props.description: Visual treatment while copied.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled state, including for non-button polymorphic roots.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon displayed in the idle state.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Position of the copy indicator icon relative to the label.

props.name: indicatorTransition
props.description: Whether to use opacity and scale cross-fade transitions during icon swaps.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Callback fired when copy succeeds.

props.name: onError
props.description: Callback fired when copy fails.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.type: (details: { copied: boolean; state: CopyState; data?: CopyData }) => void
props.description: Callback fired when copy status changes.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size, including icon-only sizes.

props.name: slotName
props.description: Root `data-slot` name

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: tone
props.description: Color tone while uncopied.

props.name: value
props.description: Value to copy to the clipboard. Accepts a string, ClipboardItem, ClipboardItem[], or an accessor returning either.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment while uncopied.
